question: A man makes a monthly payment equal to 30% of his monthly salary towards debt repayment. He spends 20% of the remaining salary and saves ₹602. His monthly salary (in ₹) is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the total monthly salary be 100%.

Net percentage of salary saved = (100% − 30%) × (100% − 20%)

⇒ Savings % = 70% × 80% = 56%

Given, 56% of Salary = ₹602

⇒ Total Salary = (602 ÷ 56) × 100 = 10.75 × 100 = 1075

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1075.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Amount paid towards debt = 30% of monthly salary

Amount spent = 20% of the remaining salary

Final savings = ₹602

 
 Salary = 100x

 

 
 Debt Repayment
 30x

 
 Remaining
 70x

 

 
 Spend (20% of 70x)
 14x

 
 Savings (80%)
 56x = ₹602

**Calculations:**

Let the total monthly salary of the man be x.

⇒ Amount left after paying debt = x − 0.30x = 0.70x

He spends 20% of the remaining amount, which implies he saves exactly 80% of the remaining amount.

⇒ Savings = 80% of 0.70x

⇒ Savings = 0.80 × 0.70x = 0.56x

It is given that his savings are ₹602.

⇒ 0.56x = 602

⇒ x = 602 ÷ 0.56

⇒ x = 60200 ÷ 56

⇒ x = ₹1075

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1075.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Income and Expenditure Relationship

The total income of a person is always equal to the sum of their total expenditure and total savings (Income = Expenditure + Savings).

Successive Percentage Changes

When successive deductions are made on a sequence of remaining values, the final value can be calculated directly by multiplying the respective multiplying factors together: Final Value = Base Value × (1 − P₁/100) × (1 − P₂/100).

Importance of Base in Percentage

Notice that "20% of the remaining" is mathematically completely different from "20% of the total". Always identify the correct reference base before multiplying the percentage value.
